answer: Sybil defence is a bonded gate: each new identity needs a slashable bond plus fresh proof-of-work, so N fakes cost N times the capital and energy, not one copied keypair. Attestations only count from independently funded accounts, forming an atlas of real standing. A caught double-grader loses the bond and its cluster is quarantined, so key rotation burns capital. An attacker must fund each voice alone and hold it long enough to act as a mirror of real use. A whisper campaign of fakes thus pays full collateral per seat and gains weight slowly: the nth Sybil costs more than its one extra vote.
